decision.summary: Retain the fixed-shape GF8 K=2 R=1 public encode and decode terminals. Clean-source same-family evidence shows large target wins, and exact-main diagnostics favor Leopard2. One unrelated K=6/2049 encode observation exceeded the aggregate two-percent noise gate but was non-credible and did not reproduce in longer focused confirmations.
decision.backend_scope: legacy-high GF8 K=2 R=1, shard_bytes >= 2048, effective AVX2 or GFNI context with the AVX2 dense XOR primitive
decision.final_gate: Do not close the parent optimization bead or freeze the selector until the current-source pure-AVX2 all-K exact-Leopard1 map has completed.

machine.resource_note: Builds and tests were serialized and memory-capped after repeated controlling-session OOMs. Cache-sensitive timings intentionally used one pinned physical core and required zero non-idle jiffy growth on its reserved SMT sibling.

same_family_clean_source_grid.promotion_rule: At least one credible five-percent target win for each requested backend and metric; no observed target or neighbor regression over two percent.

aggregate_gate.reason: One non-credible unrelated neighbor observation triggered the deliberately conservative observed-regression rule.

same_code_diagnostic_replication.note: The candidate executable predates the clean source commit but its production code is identical. It is retained only as diagnostic replication; the clean-source artifact above is the identity-bearing result.

focused_unchanged_neighbor_confirmation.interpretation: The production route is unchanged and neither longer run reproduces a material regression. The terminal-only summaries are supporting evidence, not a replacement for the final all-K campaign.

exact_leopard_main_diagnostic.reason: The frozen binaries and SMT-sibling check were valid, but the manual controller predates the campaign-wide coordinator-exclusion requirement and did not retain raw calls. These results may guide retention but cannot close the final all-K bead.
exact_leopard_main_diagnostic.method: Pinned CPU 4, sibling CPU 20 non-idle delta zero, 11 outer rounds, 9 inner iterations, approximately 128 MiB target work per measurement.
exact_leopard_main_diagnostic.coverage_note: Leopard1 requires shard bytes divisible by 64, so odd-byte target cells are excluded from the exact-main comparison.

test_scope: unaligned buffers, arbitrary tails, and guard bytes
metadata, descriptor, pointer-array, input/output, and batch overlap rejection
scalar, SSSE3, AVX2, AVX512, and GFNI public backend loops

limitations: The final authoritative pure-AVX2 all-K exact-Leopard1 map remains open.
The current crossover runner does not yet satisfy the newer global coordinator-exclusion policy; all timing in this record is classified diagnostic.
This specialization targets only K=2 R=1 and does not prove the broader GF8 objective by itself.
No TSan run was performed for this milestone; Release and ASan exercise concurrent execution of the stateless helper through a shared immutable plan.
